blurb: Guests attend yoga classes ranging from beginner Restore and Yin to dynamic Vinyasa and Hot Yoga. Classes include various styles such as Power Flow, Vinyasa Flow, Soft Flow & Restore, Yin Yoga, Hot Power Flow, and specialized courses like Hot 26 and 2 and Yin + Sound Bowls. The studio also offers a 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training program and a work exchange program for unlimited yoga passes.
